content: उद्वर्त {%a.%} .²1 Superfluous, redundant, plentiful. .²2 Left over as a remainder, surplus. .{@-र्तः@} .²1 A remainder, surplus. .²2 Excess, preponderance. .²3 Rubbing or smearing the body with perfumes. .²4 The time of destruction of the world (प्रलयकाल); उद्वर्त इव सत्त्वानां समुद्राणामभूत्स्वनः <ls>Rām. 6. 44. 18</ls>.
